answer: SELECT (d.overall_rating - b.overall_rating) * 100.0 / b.overall_rating AS pct FROM Player pd JOIN Player_Attributes d ON pd.player_api_id = d.player_api_id AND d.date = '2013-07-12 00:00:00' JOIN Player pb ON pb.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' JOIN Player_Attributes b ON pb.player_api_id = b.player_api_id AND b.date = '2013-07-12 00:00:00' WHERE pd.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'

SELECT ABS(a.jumping - b.jumping) AS diff FROM (SELECT pa.jumping FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.id = 6 ORDER BY pa.date DESC LIMIT 1) a, (SELECT pa.jumping FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.id = 23 ORDER BY pa.date DESC LIMIT 1) b

SELECT p.player_api_id FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.preferred_foot = 'right' AND pa.potential IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.player_api_id ORDER BY MIN(pa.potential) ASC LIMIT 4
SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.attacking_work_rate = 'high'

SELECT MIN(pa.date) FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Kevin Constant' AND pa.crossing = (SELECT MAX(pa2.crossing) FROM Player_Attributes pa2 JOIN Player p2 ON p2.player_api_id = pa2.player_api_id WHERE p2.player_name = 'Kevin Constant')

SELECT (a.mx - b.mx) * 100.0 / b.mx AS pct FROM (SELECT MAX(pa.overall_rating) mx FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk') a, (SELECT MAX(pa.overall_rating) mx FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Paulin Puel') b
SELECT ta.buildUpPlayPassingClass FROM Team t JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE t.team_long_name = 'FC Lorient' AND ta.date LIKE '2010-02-22%'
SELECT DISTINCT t.team_short_name FROM Team t JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe'
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player)
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE strftime('%Y', birthday) = '1970' AND strftime('%m', birthday) = '10'
